setup.workspace_state: three beads, all prior mutations flushed

commands.note: any mutation; br exports to JSONL automatically after each mutation

expected_adapter.work_revision_source: jsonl_content_hash, which satisfies the 64-hex ContentHash domain type directly
expected_adapter.validity_condition: the hash speaks for the graph only when dirty_count is 0 and db_newer is false; otherwise the database holds unexported mutations and the hash is stale
expected_adapter.stale_handling: on dirty_count above 0 or db_newer true, either request a flush-only export and re-read, or refuse the read as unbracketable; never return a stale hash as the current WorkRevision
expected_adapter.bracketing: read hash, perform the read batch, read hash again; a mismatch means the graph moved during the batch and must surface with revision-conflict semantics
